_doc: The organization's own values the CODE needs (assistant/orgcfg.py, WP5 2026-10-24). Protected core: send_identities and phone_accounts are what the send gate guards; a property-management address can never appear here (the owner 2026-09-28). What the agent LEARNS about the business lives in agent/state/org.json, not here. new_org.py writes a fresh one for a new organization.
name: example-org
_chat_thread_note: agent/thread_keys.py (the owner 2026-11-04): a Chat post with no thread of its own joins its SUBJECT's thread instead of opening a new one, and the first post under a subject is a one-line header that names the thread. chat_thread_subjects lists the organization's subjects in priority order, e.g. [{"name": "ticket", "regex": "\\b(\\d{6}-\\d{1,2})\\b", "days": 30, "label": "WO {0}"}, {"name": "unit", "regex": "\\b([A-D]\\d{2})\\b", "days": 7, "label": "{0}"}]; none = one thread per agent per day per space. chat_thread_keys false = every post opens its own thread.
